    Summary

    [edit]
    DescriptionFlag of the United States (1877–1890).svg US Flag with 38 stars. In use 4 July 1877–3 July 1890. Created by jacobolus using Adobe Illustrator, and released into the public domain.
    Date 1877
    Source No machine-readable source provided. Own work assumed (based on copyright claims).
    Author No machine-readable author provided. Jacobolus assumed (based on copyright claims).
